comments: All 6 acceptance criteria approved. Ambiguity resolutions: AMB-EC-11358-001 - the Confirmed Transfer of Control precondition is produced by every change of state of the document; test data to be established on that basis at test planning. AMB-EC-11358-002 - automation scope for this release is the UI view plus the two report APIs (eoRequestExport, eoGetDocumentActivityHistoryReport); the API contracts must be captured and HUMAN_APPROVED at Gate 2 before any acceptance criterion is asserted against them. AMB-EC-11358-003 - assert structural presence of the Control History table and its three columns only for now; exact header labels and date/time format are deferred. AMB-EC-11358-004 - use the organization accounts referenced in the story to view the transferred document.

itemDecisions.comment: Control History table appears for a financial asset with a Confirmed Transfer of Control.
Rows show transfer date, From org, To org; structural assertion only per AMB-003.
No Confirmed Transfer of Control event means no table.
Scope this release: UI view + report APIs (eoRequestExport, eoGetDocumentActivityHistoryReport). API contracts require Gate 2 HUMAN_APPROVED before assertion.
